observations: Photo 0 shows a blue frame bicycle with very thick/large tires (fat-tire style).
A front headlight/reflector area is visible near the handlebar.
A rear derailleur/gear area is visible (appears to be a geared bike).
No clear brand/model text is readable on the frame, tires, or components in the photo.
No accessories (basket, pump, lock, tools) are clearly shown—only the bicycle itself.

identity.kind: fat-tire bicycle (big tire bicycle) with front suspension

claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the bicycle only; accessories are not clearly visible or listed in the photo.

risks.risk: Whether the bicycle is actually complete (missing accessories like pump, lock, bell, reflectors, tools, or seat/handlebar parts).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing all accessories laid out on the ground next to the bike (or a video panning through the full package).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as bike only (accessories not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Tire condition and wheel integrity (sidewall cracks, punctures, bent rim) cannot be confirmed from one photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a short video spinning both wheels to show wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing inspection/possible minor repairs.

risks.risk: Brake and drivetrain condition (brake rub, weak pads, slipping gears) not testable from still images.
risks.proof: Video of a full stop test (front + rear brakes) and a gear shift test while riding or with the bike on a stand.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working perfectly (worst case: brakes/drivetrain may need service).

risks.risk: Frame size/fit and whether it matches buyer needs (seat height range, wheel size).
risks.proof: Photo showing the seatpost fully extended and a measurement/label of wheel size (e.g., tire size marking) plus rider-fit photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic fat-tire bike without confirmed sizing.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the tire size markings on both tires (sidewall text) and any brand/model labels on the frame/fork.
Show all “complete accessories” laid out in one shot next to the bike.
Provide a short video: wheel spin test (no wobble) + brake test (front and rear) + gear shift test.
response.reason: The photo confirms a fat-tire bicycle with front suspension, but the key pricing drivers (exact wheel/tire size, brand/model, and whether accessories are truly included and working condition) are not provable from the single image.
